title: Verify mastery: Provide an end-to-end ecosystem setup workflow

Its own narrative does not claim delivery: PARTIAL: the setup workflow detects the ecosystem, takes consent and applies, then summarises - verified by `tests/zc_setup_workflow.rs`: zc_setup_workflow_detect_consent_apply_summary. Residual: guiding discovery and configuration of a local runtime, an optional cloud provider, tools and policy through validated plans, and a completion check that runs a real mission and reports missing prerequisi. Prove or refute it: add a nonzero test named vc_201_069_mastery_* that exercises the capability on its production path, and record exactly which part is missing when it cannot be proven. Coverage is not mastery: this closes only when the capability is verified, and a linked closed task is not evidence.
